set.body:
Objective
Specify supported nulls, estimands, independent units, discovery/confirmation separation, nuisance/dependence treatment, Monte Carlo decision rules and a candidate higher-rank procedure before implementation.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements INF-01, INF-02, INF-03, INF-04, INF-05, GRP-02, NUM-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
statistical design; docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md inference sections; docs/scenarios; group/threshold admission records. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M0.01. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Define null and partial-null simulations, temporal/repeated-measure designs, voxel/component families, effect sizes, seeds, replicate counts and Monte Carlo uncertainty criteria.
2. Higher-rank nulls preserve lower-rank association; identify a defensible compact-space procedure and its assumptions, not all-association-destroying permutations.
3. Distinguish fixed-representation conditional inference, complete selection-aware inference, and population prevalence; unsupported claims remain explicitly unavailable.
4. Retain adverse historical group-calibration cases and decide admission thresholds before seeing new results.

Verification
Review the explicit protocol/ledger against PRD and current source; validate links and source references. No numerical passing claim follows from writing a protocol. Record exact future scenario/benchmark commands and budgets at handoff.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M0.05: Freeze the inference and known-truth calibration protocol
